This lesson covers the pack's meta-gameplay — reincarnation: open the reincarnation GUI, §3deposit§r your valuables, then press "Confirm Reincarnation" to enter a new cycle — the world is reborn and progress resets, while your deposited items travel to the next world as the reincarnation reward; your unlocked deposit rows and columns carry over too — nothing you walked is wasted.

About 5 seconds after your first login in the new cycle, the reincarnation reward is §2granted automatically§r — items spiral down one by one, walk close to pick them up, and anything beyond a full inventory drops to the ground. No manual claiming needed.

The reward is exactly what you deposited this cycle — §cgrants never accumulate across cycles§r; to carry more next time, deposit more this time.

Confirm without fear: reincarnation carries a confirmation guard, so a slip of the finger won't throw you into a new world.

Note: reincarnation only takes effect in singleplayer worlds — it does nothing on dedicated servers.

Carry a Reincarnation Crystal with you to complete this quest's retrieval — it is only inspected, never consumed.

§8§oAn ending is not the end — it is the next cycle's checkpoint.§r
